text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock B and Stock C at gains, but those gains alone did not tell me whether selling was a good decision; I should focus on future risk and return.","Buying more after prices moved down or up did not give me a reliable edge, since price changes are random; I should avoid reacting to recent moves.","I should assess the whole portfolio and preserve diversification, rather than letting the pain of losses or pleasure of gains in individual positions drive trades."]}
